brief:
The Israeli military announced a significant increase in readiness as it prepares for possible renewed fighting with Iran in the coming weeks, the Ma'an Wire reported. The escalation in alert status reflects heightened tensions between the two countries.

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu convened a security meeting Wednesday night to address the developments, signaling the gravity Israeli officials assign to the situation.

title: Israeli military raises alert level ahead of potential Iran conflict
